data.one_liner: Extensions to convert int, double, BigInt and strings to/from byte arrays with endianness control
data.what_it_does: Provides helper methods for converting common numeric types and strings to byte representations and back. Supports signed/unsigned integers of various bit widths, IEEE‑754 doubles, and fast string encoding.
use_when: You need to serialize numeric data to bytes for networking or file I/O
You want to convert strings to bytes efficiently for binary protocols
You need endianness control for cross‑platform compatibility
avoid_when: You require high‑performance binary serialization beyond simple conversions
You need advanced encoding like Base64 or custom binary formats
You are building a full serialization framework
strengths: Supports multiple bit widths and endianness
weaknesses: Limited to basic types, no complex object serialization
No support for custom encoders or compression
